dct_title_s: Plans on the West Coast of Celebes
dct_description_sm: Depths shown by soundings, relief by form lines and spot heights.
In Japanese, with title and map text also in English.
Year published "大正7年" taken from left margin.
Shows depths, low water areas, reefs, drainage, peaks, roads, Makassar city plan with facilities (in Japanese).
Chart 1. Western Channels of Hoek van Labakkang and Approaches [Scale approximately 1:59,055] -- Chart 2. Makassar Road [Scale approximately 1:31,496]
